messages:
Lia Chen: Quick sync — SOC2 sprint handoff. We need a final owner list for KMS/HSM tasks before fieldwork on Mon. Who's taking the staging cutover window?
Kevin Park: I can own the staging cutover for keystore + KMS smoke. Need a co-owner for HSM attestation steps.
Maria Gomez: Security will own attestation verification and evidence collection. @Kevin can you confirm access to staging HSM attest logs?
Kevin Park: Not yet — infra needs a service account. @Sam can you open the SA and grant read-only to /hsm/attest-logs?
Sam Ortiz: Yep will do. I'll create SA 'svc-attest-read' and add it to the staging IAM group. ETA 2h.
Lia Chen: Thanks. Also need confirmation on audit-log backfill script status (we promised infra team a backfill for last 30 days). Who's on that?
Jasmine Li: Product is tracking the backfill as part of the evidence pack. @Kevin is the backfill runner in infra or eng-sre?
Kevin Park: infra provides the job runner but we need the script from eng-platform. I can run once script is in /deploy/scripts/audit-backfill.sh.
Maria Gomez: We have a vetted script in the security repo but it's got an env var that needs redaction before we hand it over. I can sanitize and push a clean version by EOD.
Lia Chen: Great. Action items so far: Kevin -> staging cutover owner + backfill runner; Sam -> create SA; Maria -> sanitize script. Anyone to own evidence packaging and upload to audit drop?
Jasmine Li: I can coordinate packaging and upload to the auditors' SFTP. Need the final timestamps and the canonical manifest format: 
```
manifest:
  - service: keystore
  - pkgs: [auditlog, attest]
  - range: 2024-11-01..2024-11-30
```
(Example)
Kevin Park: I will add the exact time windows after cutover test. We'll use monotonic UTC timestamps.
Sam Ortiz: SA created: svc-attest-read. I added to staging-ops group and notified Kevin.
audit-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence deadline in 6 days. Open tasks: attestation-verification, auditbackfill, evidence-upload.
Maria Gomez: Script sanitized and PR opened: security/auditbackfill#42. Please review.
Lia Chen: Quick dependency check: any blocker from vendors or shared infra?
Kevin Park: Vendor HSM firmware patch scheduled Thu night — that might affect attestation if it slips. We need contingency: shift our fieldwork slot by 24h or use fallback HSM cluster (non-prod).
Jasmine Li: Auditors prefer production-correlated logs but will accept non-prod if documented. Let's document fallback in the manifest if we use it.
Lia Chen: Sounds good. Final ask: everyone add a one-line status to the handoff doc (links in #confluence). I'll collate and DM the auditors.
Maria Gomez: Done — added verification checklist.
Kevin Park: Added cutover runbook and rollback steps.
Sam Ortiz: Noted. If anything blocks SA or network, ping me directly.
Lia Chen: Thanks all. I'll re-post summary at 1719050360 and mark owners.
Lia Chen: SUMMARY (owners): Kevin - staging cutover & backfill runner; Maria - script + evidence verification; Sam - SA & infra ops; Jasmine - packaging + auditor upload. Blocker: vendor firmware patch (contingency documented).
